# Production sprite sources

All files are deterministic crops or 2× nearest-neighbor derivatives of CC0 assets.

- `traffic-signal`, `trash-bin`, `traffic-cone`, `manhole`, `road-crack`, `storm-drain`: LPC Modern Streets by Faufilage, CC0 1.0.
- `fire-hydrant`, `mailbox`, `vending-machine`, `flower-box`: Kenney RPG Urban Pack, CC0 1.0.

Original archives, hashes and source URLs remain in `assets/third-party/city-assets/`.
